title: Hard distribution lower bound for majority
statement: Let $T$ be a finite decision tree on three sign-valued coordinates, with sign-valued outputs, that computes majority on three signs (with ties assigned the positive sign). When the input is formed by choosing a sign and one of the three coordinates uniformly and setting that coordinate to the opposite sign and the other two to the chosen sign, the expected number of queries made by $T$ is at least $8/3$.
hypotheses_covered: T is a finite decision tree on three coordinates with sign-valued queries and outputs
T computes majority on three signs, with ties assigned the positive sign
The hard input distribution is obtained by uniformly choosing a sign and coordinate and flipping that coordinate
